chemistry.source: 6.csv column 1 (display name) matched to data/clean/q2_chem_meta.json corrLabel, then name, after q2_lib.normalise_label (lower case, alphanumerics only)
chemistry.duplicateNormalisedLabelNote: E-alpha-ionone and E-beta-ionone both normalise to 'eionone' (Greek letters are stripped). No 6.csv row uses that label, so 44/44 rows resolve; if one ever did, the run aborts instead of picking a feature by position.

sensory.source: explicit literal 50-entry dictionary, cross-checked against MathorCup_A_独立审查与重跑方案/sensory_name_alignment.csv and the 6.csv header set

no two 6.csv rows map to the same feature
meta corrIndex equals the FEATURE_COLS position for every matched row
every 6.csv sensory column maps to exactly one of the 50 targets
literal dictionary == alignment table == 6.csv header set

category_counts.reason: meta tags 219 single_compound features; the 3 element_or_index members (iron, protein.g.L., betaglucan.mg.L.) are reclassified out of the strict universe, 219 - 3 = 216

modules.definition: connected components of the point-estimate training graph |W| > 0 at tau = 0.5 over the 231 chemistry features (200 SPLIT-0001 train rows)
modules.readingNote: the partition is UNBALANCED: one component absorbs most features, so the 'rank 4..10 inside the same module' substitute pool is nearly the global next-best list for most picks. moduleSize is reported next to every alternative so this is visible, not hidden.

external_6csv.status: SAME-SOURCE corroboration, NOT independent external validation: 6.csv ships with the same attachment and never enters the Top-3 selection. It only says our |Spearman| matrix agrees in rank with the table the attachment itself provides.
external_6csv.alignment: rows by chemistry display name -> corrLabel/name; columns by explicit name dictionary
external_6csv.supersededNote: the previous 0.445051 value is reproduced by the positional-column + 219/231 index mix; it is a misalignment artefact, not a chemistry finding

method.consensus: mean of the three within-dimension percentile ranks over the board's own candidate universe
method.rankingRule: pi first, then the point-estimate score, then the fixed feature name (Unicode order)

metricDefinitions.topk-jaccard: mean over repeats, the 50 dimensions and the 6 method pairs of J = |A n B|/(2k-|A n B|) with k = 3, on the delivered pi-first sets (main metric)
metricDefinitions.topk-jaccard-point: same statistic on the point-estimate Top-3 sets
metricDefinitions.cross_repeat_jaccard: same statistic between the delivered sets of two repeats
metricDefinitions.external_6csv_mean_spearman_aligned: mean over 50 dimensions of Spearman(|our rho|, |6.csv value|) after name alignment on BOTH sides
metricDefinitions.pi_mean: mean selection frequency of the delivered strict entries, pooled over the four methods and the repeats run (600 delivered strict entries per repeat)
metricDefinitions.pi_below_0.5_count: delivered strict entries with pi < 0.5, pooled over the four methods and the repeats run (denominator = pi_below_0.5_denominator)
metricDefinitions.sign_stability_mean: mean share of replicates with a positive signed total Spearman for the delivered strict entries, pooled over the four methods and the repeats run
metricDefinitions.n_strict_candidates: size of the strict single_compound universe

tableSchema.strict_top3.csv / extended_top3.csv: the requested 12 columns, exactly; the DELIVERED consensus Top-3 (50 dimensions x 3 ranks = 150 rows), so the file is unambiguous without a method column
tableSchema.strict_top3_by_method.csv / extended_top: same 12 columns in the same order plus `method` as the 13th column: all four methods x 50 dimensions x 3 ranks = 600 rows, the full per-method evidence
tableSchema.note: the requested schema has no method field, so a 600-row file with only those 12 columns would let four different sets share one (dimension, rank) key. Splitting the delivered consensus table from the by-method evidence avoids that ambiguity.
tableSchema.alternative_rank4: the 4th-ranked candidate of the SAME reference module; the literal string 'none' means that module has fewer than 4 members (an empty cell would read back as NaN). outputs.module_alternatives then still gives the board-wide next-best candidate in globalFallback, labelled as not same-module.

notes: 6.csv 只做同源对照（与附件同源），不是独立外部验证；它不参与任何 Top-3 选择，读取发生在榜单固定之后。
一致性/稳定性不是准确率：evidence_status 只是稳定性标签（pi 与符号一致性），不是正确性判断。
不对任何化合物-感官相关做因果解释；这里只有同一批 200 行训练数据上的相关与回归系数。
严格榜只含 single_compound（216 项）；iron / protein.g.L. / betaglucan.mg.L. 归 element_or_index，7 项理化参数与 5 项汇总指标进扩展榜，均不进严格榜。
本轮不加 T/W 双轨，方法仍是 total_spearman / within_style_spearman / graph_lowrank / consensus。
bootstrap 每个重复 500 次（--reps 可改；实际次数写在 outputs.bootstrap.reps 与 metrics.bootstrap_reps，不写死 500）。
交付集（sets.json / strict_top3.csv）用 pi 优先排序；同分先看点估计强度，再按固定特征名。
第 3 名不稳（pi < 0.5）时，同参考模块内排名 4–10 的替代项同时给出（alternative_rank4 与 outputs.module_alternatives），不隐藏；模块成员不足 4 个时 alternative_rank4 写 'none'，outputs 里另给 globalFallback（全局次优，标注为非同模块）。
参考模块划分在 tau=0.5 下很不均衡（一个连通分量吸收绝大多数特征），所以“同模块 4–10 名”在多数维度上接近全局次优候选；每条替代项都同时报 moduleSize，让这一点可见而不是被隐藏。
strict_top3.csv / extended_top3.csv 是 consensus 方法的交付表（150 行，12 列）；四方法完整证据在 strict_top3_by_method.csv / extended_top3_by_method.csv（600 行，12 列 + method）。
candidate_scores.csv 的 score 是候选所在榜（严格/扩展）内的 consensus 百分位；pi 是 consensus 方法的选择频率。
bootstrap_pi.csv 记录每次重采样的 Top-3（50 维 × 4 方法 × 3 = 300 行/次），所以每个 pi 都能从文件无损重建；扩展榜的次数表在同目录 bootstrap_pi_extended.csv。
repeat>0 目录里的 metrics.json 与主目录内容相同（三次重复池化口径）；该次重复自身的指标在 outputs.json 的 metrics 字段与 per_repeat 里。

jaccard.definition: J = |A n B| / (2k - |A n B|) with k = 3; mean over 50 dimensions and the 6 method pairs; delivered sets are pi-first, point sets are the point-estimate Top-3

threshold.note: labels only: stability is not accuracy

refitPerReplicate: graph low-rank regression (rank 6, lambda 1, gamma 0.1, 25 ALS sweeps)
bootstrap.signStability: share of replicates with signed total Spearman > 0

refitPerReplicate: graph low-rank regression (rank 6, lambda 1, gamma 0.1, 25 ALS sweeps)
0.signStability: share of replicates with signed total Spearman > 0

contract.note: repeat 0 goes through the frozen channel; repeats > 0 are written directly by this script and are marked as such in their own outputs.json
